explanation_full: The XGBoost model's performance metrics are clearly presented in the scatter plot diagnostics. Specifically, the model achieved an R2 score of 0.7495, indicating a strong proportion of variance explained. The Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) was calculated at 0.1325, and the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was 0.0956. Furthermore, the correlation between predicted and actual values was 0.875024, suggesting a strong positive linear relationship. The linear fit slope was 0.838684, and the maximum absolute residual observed was 0.410478.
